title: Will Jackson Olson and their partner be eliminated from Dancing with the Stars Season 35 before Oct 14, 2026?
rules: If Jackson Olson and their partner are officially eliminated from Dancing with the Stars Season 35 before Oct 14, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
The declaration must be made through official program broadcast, website, verified social media, or press releases.
If the season is canceled without declaring eliminations, the market resolves to No.

Payout criteria
Elimination includes being voted off, evicted, knocked out, removed from further contention, voluntary withdrawal, disqualification, or producer removal.
Multiple simultaneous eliminations count.
Initial elimination counts even if the contestant later returns.

Doesn't count for payout
Eliminations immediately reversed in the same episode don't count.
Temporary suspensions, medical holds, or being runner-up in the finale don't count as elimination.

blind.reasoning: Only one episode (Oct 13, Super Bowl Night) airs before the market closes, with 11 couples left and normally one elimination, so the base rate is about 9%. Olson's judges' scores are lower-middle (15, 18, 18), but he has survived four weeks and likely has a strong viewer vote from the Savannah Bananas fan base. No double elimination has been announced, so the estimate sits slightly below the uniform base rate.
blind.falsifier: Jackson Olson and Emma Slater are announced as eliminated on the October 13 Super Bowl Night episode, including through a surprise double elimination, or Olson withdraws before then.

final.reasoning: The 25.5% market price suggests information I couldn't verify, such as a weak Week 4 result or a possible double elimination, so I raised my estimate from 8% to 12%. With only one episode left among 11 couples and Olson surviving four weeks, 25% still looks too high, so I'd buy NO.
